name: Euro Balanced Multi-Asset Fund
description: Non-UCITS AIFMD fund holding 40-60% European equities and 40-60% investment-grade bonds, with a derivatives overlay (interest-rate and FX hedges). PRIIPs Category 2 (non-linear payoff); VEV ~8-12% → MRM class 3; issuer basket CRM class 2 → SRI 3 per Commission Delegated Regulation EU 2017/653 Annex II CRM-MRM lookup table (CR2/MR3=3). Classified COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(b) due to embedded derivative strategies that make it difficult for a retail investor to understand the risk profile without intermediary explanation.
